scope: Ten additional DISTINCT unique oil work keys not among audit18 or followup10, selected systematically in calendar order
safeguards: Do not replace owner-selected artworks or revive globally rejected originals
Museum page or object PD != license for an exact photographic file
Source index snippets count as provisional catalogue evidence, not direct page verification
No new date-specific editorial approval; retain previous 198-edge research triage
All 10 entries require source bytes, exact-source image licence, color and phone composition checks before release

records.title: Madonna incoronata coi Santi Bernardo, Francesco Saverio, Tommaso, Maria Maddalena de' Pazzi, Ilario, Giovanni Battista
records.note: Parma, Galleria Nazionale / Palazzo della Pilotta, inv. 1191; about 1687–1688; St Hilary of Poitiers is one of numerous saints, not the sole subject. Crop may suppress him.

records.title: Saint Raymund of Pennafort Venerating the Child
records.note: S-43 oil on canvas. Museum marks page Public Domain and offers IIIF manifest https://imagehub.mskgent.be/iiif/3/6344/manifest.json; image-rights page permits collection-image resolutions offered online but sends high-res/commercial use to Art in Flanders. Distinguish St Raymund of Pennafort from St Raymond Nonnatus; museum subject keywords misleadingly call him founder of Mercedarians.

records.title: St. Francis de Sales
records.note: Slovene Museum of Christianity listing, registration ŠLU 36; first half 19th century; oval portrait. Official page marks © Slovene Museum of Christianity. No image-source reuse cleared.

records.title: San Paolo della Croce
records.note: 19th-century oil painting at San Gallicano, Rome. Saint with Passionist rule, cross-heart emblem and angels; object page licenses only metadata CC BY 4.0, not a chosen photo.

records.title: Portrait of Pope Pius V
records.note: Walters dates c. 1566, oil on canvas; says likely workshop replica after lost original. Page explicitly marks Creative Commons Zero and offers image download; cannot assign full photograph SHA, image-size or crop approval until acquiring the selected file.
records.downloadCandidateVerification: Official museum download link is present on CC0 page; browsing returned image/jpg MIME unsupported by text reader. Local image download failed due network access; no photo bytes, dimensions, SHA or mobile QA were established.

records.title: Papa Pio V in preghiera per la battaglia di Lepanto
records.note: Racconigi Castle inv. 835. Pius V kneels in prayer while naval battle is seen through window; object location was reverified in 2016, despite 2002 storage uncertainty. No image rights cleared.

records.title: Biskup Stanisław Szczepanowski rzucający klątwę na króla Bolesława Śmiałego
records.note: c. 1840. Official catalogue lists alternative titles spanning excommunication, murder, blessing his killers and death; do not assume exact action from title without photo inspection. Public-domain copyright classification listed but no named source photograph license/bytes established.

records.title: Saint Jean-Baptiste de la Salle
records.note: First-quarter 19th-century bust portrait in Reims birthplace; catalogue says possibly a replica after a lost early-18th-century painting, also possibly copy after another. Protected object privately owned. Archival photograph numbers not permission to reproduce.

records.title: Madonna con Bambino e Sant'Ubaldo
records.note: c. 1680, in Rimini, 313x220cm. Saint Ubaldus kneels toward Virgin and Child; two possessed people at lower left; heavy historic overpainting largely reversed by 1972 restoration. Full-frame composition/crop will need inspection.

records.title: San Venanzio martire
records.note: Maranello, oil canvas; full-length armour-clad Venantius with red cloak and flag. Catalogue credits Rizzi Carlo while critical note proposes attribution to Carlo Ricci; preserve name/attribution uncertainty, do not silently standardize maker.
